我.note: A hand holding a weapon — standing up for oneself: 'I'.

你.note: The person radical 亻 marks words about people.

好.note: A woman with her child — the picture of 'good'.

妈.note: 女 gives the meaning (woman), 马 mǎ gives the sound.

吃.note: 口 mouth tells you it involves the mouth: eating.

说.note: 讠 is the speech radical, found in most talking words.

请.note: Speech radical + a sound hint: to request politely.

谢.note: Speech again — thanking is something you say.

河.note: 氵 is water squeezed thin — rivers, seas, washing.

汉.note: Water radical; 汉 refers to the Han people and their language.

冰.note: Two strokes 冫 mean ice, not water — cold things.

热.note: 灬 at the bottom is 火 fire flattened out — heat.

烤.note: Fire on the left — to roast or bake.

饭.note: 饣 is the food radical — anything edible.

馆.note: Food radical — a place that serves food.

餐.note: 食 is food in full form — a meal.

树.note: 木 is a tree — wood and plant words.

休.note: A person resting against a tree — to rest.

看.parts: 手 hand over 目 eye
看.note: A hand shading the eyes to look into the distance.

时.note: Sun radical — time was told by the sun.

钱.note: 钅 is the metal radical — coins were metal.

路.note: 足 is the foot radical — roads and walking.

心.note: A drawing of a heart — feelings and thought.

想.note: Heart at the base — to think, to miss, to want.

怕.note: 忄 is the heart squeezed sideways — emotions.

快.note: Heart radical — quick, and also happy.

目.note: An eye turned on its side.

车.note: A cart seen from above — vehicles.

鱼.note: A fish, head at the top, fins at the base.

鸟.note: A bird with its eye and tail feathers.

马.note: A horse with its mane and legs.

鹿.note: A deer with antlers — the 鹿 in 麋鹿.

麋.note: Deer radical + 米 mí for the sound — Père David's deer.

熊.note: The bear in 熊猫, panda — literally 'bear cat'.

猫.note: 犭 is the dog/beast radical, on most four-legged animals.

裤.note: 衤 is 衣 squeezed sideways — garment words.

子.note: A swaddled baby with arms out.

人.note: A person walking, seen from the side.

大.note: A person with arms stretched wide — big.

上.note: A mark above the line — up, on.

下.note: A mark below the line — down, under.

中.note: A line through the centre of a box — middle.

日.note: The sun with a mark in the middle.

水.note: A stream with ripples either side.

手.note: A hand with fingers and a wrist.

问.note: A mouth at the door — to ask.

间.note: Sun through a doorway — a space, a gap, a room.
